name: Текст
prompt: Abstract calligraphic strokes of glowing deep blue and warm gold light drift through dark infinite space, swirling like ink in water and gathering into a soft luminous spiral. No letters, no words, no readable text, no symbols. Cinematic, ethereal, smooth slow camera push-in, from chaos to order, mysterious mood, shallow depth of field, volumetric light.
prompt_initial: Abstract text fragments, glowing deep blue and warm gold, float and slowly assemble into words in a dark, infinite space. Cinematic, ethereal, smooth camera push-in. From chaos to order, mysterious mood.
prompt_change_reason: Первый дубль показал крупную читаемую надпись «BEYOND THE VEIL». В промпт добавлен явный запрет букв и слов, а «assembling into words» заменено на «luminous spiral».
